_about: Real programmes and activities run at Singapore Active Ageing Centres, gathered from NTUC Health monthly schedules, THK, REACH, TOUCH, PCF Sparkle, KWSH, Lions Befrienders, MOH and PA pages (Nov 2026). Cadences are what centres actually run. Use to seed circles' gatherings, marketplace opportunities and Wisdom topics.

circles_it_maps_to.origin_circles: Malay Dance, Chinese calligraphy, kuih cooking, Bolayu dance = where people are from; language classes per mother tongue
circles_it_maps_to.faith_festival_circles: Festive celebrations, inter-generational events, community meals
circles_it_maps_to.place_circles: RC-level groups, Coffee Corner kakis, community garden crews, estate walking groups
circles_it_maps_to.life_circles: Uncle Time (retired men), former-trade groups, Silver Guardians, micro-jobbers
circles_it_maps_to.interest_circles: Chess, knitting, karaoke/ukulele, gardening, line dance, tai chi, golf, e-sports, sewing, baking

high_engagement_signals: Daily drop-in centres (open weekdays, some daily 6am-10pm like THK Bedok)
Weekly fixed classes seniors book and never miss (taichi 9:15am, line dance 9am - real times)
Monthly birthdays, festivals and outings on a public calendar
Befriending phone calls and doorstep visits for the homebound
Volunteering roles with real responsibility (Silver Guardian, garden crew, micro-jobber)
Students-to-teachers paths (robotics seniors who then teach)
Communal meals and makan sessions = strongest attendance driver
